text: Thank you for coming in; you mentioned a concerning rash and recent health changes. To help me understand what's going on, can you describe where the rash is located and what it looks like?

speaker: Patient
text: 47-year-old male. The patient presents with a rash that started last night, finding it very concerning. speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Drug reaction with eosinophilia and systemic symptoms (DRESS) syndrome.

I will proceed to confirm the specific medication he started for his arthritis and evaluate his recent cough, as these suggest a possible systemic reaction to a new drug. Can you tell me the name of the medication you recently started for your arthritis?
